name: Vertex AI Agent Builder
summary: Google Cloud's managed platform for building and deploying agents: Agent Development Kit, managed Agent Engine runtime, RAG Engine, and Google Cloud IAM, billing, and observability.

agent-runtime.note: Agent Development Kit plus the managed Agent Engine runtime with sessions.

orchestration.note: Multi-agent composition in ADK (sequential, parallel, loop agents); broader pipelines lean on other Google Cloud services.

knowledge-memory.note: RAG Engine and Vertex AI Search for grounding; Memory Bank for session memory.

tools-integration.note: Function tools, MCP support, and prebuilt connectors to Google and third-party systems.

identity-governance.note: Google Cloud IAM, quotas, and audit logging — cloud-level, not agent-action-level; no built-in guardrail/approval queue for tool calls.

observability.note: Cloud Trace/Logging integration and Agent Engine tracing of agent runs.

data-secrets.note: Via adjacent Google Cloud services (Cloud Storage, Secret Manager) rather than the agent platform itself.

evaluation.note: Vertex AI evaluation service with agent-specific evaluation flows.

channels.note: Chat-platform delivery through Conversational Agents (Dialogflow) channel integrations, adjacent to Agent Builder itself.

code-execution.note: Built-in code execution tooling in ADK and the Vertex AI code interpreter extension.
